name: bAbI Dialog API Calls
summary: 11,956 next-response choices from 2,000 simulated restaurant-booking dialogs.
overview: The first bAbI Dialog task tests whether a simulated restaurant-booking assistant can gather the needed details and form the appropriate API-call response. The assistant chooses a reply at each turn given the preceding dialog. [Original study, Section 3](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1605.07683)
methodology: The snapshot includes the complete standard and out-of-vocabulary Task 1 test files, with 1,000 dialogs in each. Each task represents one response choice and includes the recorded customer and bot history up to the current customer message. The evaluator presents the 4,212 released candidate responses. The keys identify the split, dialog, and response turn. The date is the first public version of the study, and the SHA-256 identifies the archive used here. [Original study, Table 1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1605.07683), [First public study version](https://arxiv.org/abs/1605.07683v1), [Archive manifest](https://github.com/facebookresearch/ParlAI/blob/ea366da91c93f2cec8fe29b6d93b37ed96ed45bd/parlai/tasks/dialog_babi/build.py)
scoring: A response is correct when it selects the released reference candidate. Report response accuracy and the fraction of dialogs whose responses are all correct separately for the standard and out-of-vocabulary sets. [Original study, Section 5](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1605.07683)
limitations: The dialogs are generated by a task-specific simulator, and each turn uses a fixed set of candidate texts. This measures agreement with the recorded response choices. Repeated dialog histories are part of the release. The 369 groups of repeated prompts retain all 3,272 additional occurrences and have matching reference labels within each group. [Original study, Sections 3 and 5](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1605.07683), [Pinned archive manifest](https://github.com/facebookresearch/ParlAI/blob/ea366da91c93f2cec8fe29b6d93b37ed96ed45bd/parlai/tasks/dialog_babi/build.py)
